gen-vast-shadow-gf-stack-sans-text: Vintage swagger fills Vast Shadow, every stroke cut to one width and each letter given room to breathe, while the body steps in quietly. Vast Shadow grabs the eye first; Stack Sans Text, a plain sans, does the patient work.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-sulphur-point: Vast Shadow stands out for its tall mean line, a vintage display face with strokes cut to a single width. Sulphur Point takes over for the quieter job, its sans letters holding distinct gaps and a marker-like line.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-tiktok-sans: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width, with no thin parts anywhere. TikTok Sans follows in sans-serif, its lowercase rising close to the capitals, so the heading's vintage punch lands beside a body that feels modern and open.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans reads as a plain sans with big, open lowercase eyes and tubular strokes, curves left slightly unfinished. Over a full page it moves smoothly and feels modern, while Vast Shadow stays up top.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans reads like a ruler-drawn line, with wide unclosed curve endings and lowercase that fills the line. Vast Shadow, vintage and tall in its mean line, brings the swagger while this sans handles the talking.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-victor-mono: Vintage and loud, Vast Shadow cuts each stroke to one width with generous space around every letter. And Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side, reads structured and precise over a longer stretch.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-yaldevi: Glass tubing bent into letters, that is Vast Shadow, vintage and eye-catching with a tall mean line. And Yaldevi, a plain sans with outsized lowercase and an e that opens to the right, gives it a clean, easygoing partner.
gen-vast-shadow-source-serif-4: Vast Shadow has a pipe-cleaner feel in every letterform, tall in the lowercase and vintage in mood. But Source Serif 4, a serif with a hint of wedge-shaped pen pressure, brings a moderate, dignified body that would hold up if the heading shrank.
gen-zen-dots-fs-hind: Hind reads as a plain sans with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and ends of the c that never turn inward, steady as a drawn string. Zen Dots brings the tech-flavored friendliness above it.
gen-zen-dots-fs-nunito: Techy and friendly, Zen Dots gives every letter lots of room and keeps its openings generous. Nunito, a sans with big round lowercase bowls and terminals that finish clear of the stem, would read softly and comfortably across a long passage.
